So before writing anything I made a quick mental inventory of the nine elements and tried to rank them by how much space they would consume. I then counted words, found I was over, cut connective tissue, recounted, and adjusted until I reached twelve. The hyphenated compounds were the main tool I used to stay within the limit while keeping the content.

That is genuinely how I went about it.
